image_description: Three men standing outdoors holding two large sturgeon fish vertically. The man in the center wears a white long-sleeved shirt with text and graphics, flanked by two other men in darker clothing. Both fish are held by their tails or lower bodies, displaying their elongated forms, scutes, and heads.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with protrusible mouth on ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both fish clearly display the characteristic elongated snout and the mouth is positioned on the underside (ventral) of the head, consistent with sturgeon anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Four barbels (sensory whiskers) anterior to mouth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: On the fish held by the man on the left, four distinct barbels are visible hanging down from the snout area. On the right fish, they are also visible though slightly less sharp due to angle/resolution.
The snouts of both fish are distinctly pointed and elongated, matching the sturgeon profile.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated fusiform body with impressively large, extended proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both fish exhibit the classic torpedo-like (fusiform) shape and are quite large relative to the humans holding them, indicating significant length and girth.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five rows of bony scutes (plates) along body instead of scales.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct rows of raised, bony plates (scutes) are visible running longitudinally along the sides and back of both fish. They lack typical fish scales.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gray, brown, or black dorsally with lighter ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal side (back) of the fish is dark gray/brown, while the belly/ventral side appears significantly lighter, consistent with natural counter-shading.
The tail fins of both fish show the heterocercal structure where the upper lobe is larger and extends further than the lower lobe, a key primitive trait of sturgeons.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the shirt reads 'We Are NORT...' but the subsequent letters/graphic elements become distorted and nonsensical. The graphic below the text also lacks clear semantic structure, typical of AI-generated apparel text.

While the scutes are present, the texture between them appears somewhat smooth and plastic-like rather than having the rough, leathery skin texture often seen in high-res photos of sturgeon. However, this could be due to image compression or wetness.

The hands holding the fish, particularly the right hand of the central figure and the left hand of the figure on the right, appear slightly fused with the fish body or lack distinct finger definition, showing minor structural ambiguity.
